  • Constructor Details

    • PhysicsBox

      public PhysicsBox(float xdim, float ydim, float zdim, float mass, org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f position, org.jogamp.vecmath.Quat4f attitude, org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3D graphicalObject, Integrator integrator, float restitution, float friction)
      Creates a new instance of the PhyusicsBox class. Creates a rigid body box to use in a physics simulation. The box position and attitude will be used to animate the given Component3D.
      Parameters:
      xdim - the size in X-dimension.
      ydim - the size in Y-dimension.
      zdim - the size in Z-dimension.
      mass - the mass of the box in kilograms.
      position - the starting centerpoint of the box.
      attitude - the orientation of the box expressed as a Quaternion, will be normalized by constructor.
      graphicalObject - the Component3D that will be animated by the box.
      restitution - the coefficient of restitution used to model the elasticity of the box.
      friction - the coefficient of restitution used to model the elasticity of the box.

    • getNormals

      public void getNormals(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f[] normals)
      Calculates the normals for the box's planes. Will write three normals into the supplied array of vectors. Note that even though a box has six sides they are pairwies parallell and hence only have three non parallell normals.
      Parameters:
      normals - an array of vectors with at least three spaces.

    • getCollisionNormal

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f getCollisionNormal(PhysicsBox box)
      Tries to find a separating plane between this box and the given one. If none is found there is an overlap along the normal with the least overlap. If an overlap is found the collision normal is returned, otherwise null is returned.
      Returns:
      the collision normal if there is a collision, null otherwise.

    • getPlanesWithNormal

      public BoxPlane[] getPlanesWithNormal(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f normal)
      Tries to find two planes on this box with normals parallel to the given vector. If two planes are found that are close enough to bieng parallel with the given vector, they are returned. If no planes are found null is returned.
